requirement: Tauri app, native engine worker, bundled dependency runtime, on-demand approved model workers.
acceptance: One installed app; end users do not install Node, a compiler, Python or pip packages manually.

requirement: JUCE-backed native device path, declared OS/backend matrix, channel mapping, sample-rate/buffer negotiation and hot-plug handling.
acceptance: Exactly one device/transport owner. Detect unsupported settings and expose monitoring latency rather than hiding it.

requirement: Bound waveform tiles, sample preloads, undo snapshots, decoded media, model caches, visual textures and pending jobs separately.
acceptance: Cancellation releases reservations; long-session tests show bounded steady-state memory. Streaming is preferred to decoding all media.

requirement: Dedicated native callback path, preallocated data structures, bounded queues and off-thread graph preparation/destruction.
acceptance: At 48 kHz, 128 frames represent about 2.67 ms per callback—not end-to-end round-trip latency. Instrument deadlines and dropouts.

requirement: Versioned project container, immutable hashed media, engine snapshot, SQLite metadata, journal/checkpoint recovery and migrations.
acceptance: Disk-full, crash, interrupted write and missing media cannot silently produce a successful save.

requirement: HTTPS object storage/CDN, versioned signed manifests, checksum verification, resumable downloads and local cache quota.
acceptance: Model/content packs are optional. Reject tampered, unapproved or incompatible packages. No automatic code execution from downloads.

requirement: CPU/RAM/GPU admission control, bounded priority queue, cancellation, timeout, progress and limited worker concurrency.
acceptance: Recording/performance mode can suspend heavy jobs. Small predictive work and large generation do not launch an uncontrolled competition for GPU memory.

requirement: Store model/revision/hash, preprocessing, parameters, input hashes, seed where available, licences and acceptance history.
acceptance: Preferences are inspectable/deletable and project-scoped by default; training on private songs is not automatic.

requirement: Separate scanner, timeout/quarantine database, version/architecture checks, state snapshots and missing-plugin placeholders.
acceptance: Distinguish scanner safety from processing isolation. A broken plugin never silently corrupts the project; deliberate failure has a tested restore path.

requirement: Narrow Tauri capabilities, authenticated local IPC, worker filesystem scopes, safe archive/media import and no unnecessary network listener.
acceptance: Treat native plugins and generated shaders as untrusted. Process separation alone is not an OS permission sandbox.

requirement: Audio-clock snapshots, calibrated output latency, distinct preview/program output, frame dropping and pre-rendered fallback.
acceptance: Visuals may drop a frame; audio may not wait for visuals. Generated or imported clips share the same revisioned timing model.

requirement: Cargo workspace + CMake/Ninja native targets + a locked frontend build; a locked Python packaging path only for selected workers.
acceptance: Pin compilers, target triples, submodules, feature flags and runtime libraries. Version the protocol between independently built artifacts.

requirement: Native runners per OS, compilation caches, tests, SBOM, dependency/advisory checks, licences/notices, artifact hashes and reproducible build inputs.
acceptance: Do not expose signing keys or run untrusted pull-request code on privileged hardware runners. Set job timeouts and cancel superseded builds.

requirement: macOS signing/notarization, Windows signing/installer verification, Linux packaging and signed Tauri update manifests.
acceptance: Update install/restart is blocked during recording/performance. Test interrupted updates and restore the last supported project format.

requirement: Structured process logs, native crash reports/symbols, latency/dropout counters and explicit exportable diagnostic bundles.
acceptance: No raw audio, private prompts, plugin secrets or full project content in telemetry by default. Retain logs with size/time limits.

requirement: Real audio interfaces, MIDI/MPE controllers, multiple sample rates/buffers, external displays, OS versions and GPU backends.
acceptance: Software CI alone is not an audio-latency or hardware-compatibility certificate. Publish only the measured device matrix.

requirement: A small authenticated API, durable job queue, object storage, GPU workers, quotas, cancellation, audit and explicit upload consent.
acceptance: Cloud unavailability never blocks manual editing/playback. Do not require a Kubernetes cluster, vector database or training farm for the first desktop release.

requirement: Account/org permissions, encrypted transport, object-level sharing, revision conflicts, audit and explicit export/restore behavior.
acceptance: Do not cloud-sync the live SQLite WAL or introduce distributed real-time audio edits in F1. Add collaboration after stable local revision semantics.

requirement: Software licences, model licences, sample/preset/font/IR rights, contributor notices, codec patent review and distribution source archives.
acceptance: A MIT player does not make its samples MIT. A model’s permissive weight licence does not guarantee copyright clearance for every input/output.

requirement: Stable/beta channels, dependency owner, backport policy, incident playbook, recovery documentation and compatibility registry.
acceptance: No unattended dependency-major upgrades. Vulnerabilities trigger evaluated patches, not unsupervised rebuilds of the production audio stack.
